entries.name: Highlight term
entries.description: Highlights a key term with backticks so it reads as a defined concept. Use for domain terms the model must treat precisely.
entries.example: The term `intent` refers to the user's actual goal.

entries.name: Attention marker
entries.description: Marks one instruction as critical and non-negotiable. Use sparingly — overuse dilutes the priority signal.
entries.example: 🎯 Always include contact information.

entries.name: Placeholder
entries.example: Name: {user.name}
entries.description: Standard placeholder the model substitutes with a concrete value. Use for required variables.

entries.name: Empty placeholder (inferred)
entries.description: Empty placeholder — the model infers a sensible value from context. Use when any reasonable value is acceptable.
entries.example: Status: {user.status}

entries.name: Unicode placeholder
entries.description: Unicode-bracket placeholder for use where angle or curly brackets would collide with content.

entries.name: Placeholder + qualifier
entries.description: Placeholder with a pipe qualifier steering how the value is generated.

entries.name: In-fill (generate)
entries.example: Bio: [...:2-3sentences| professional tone]
entries.description: Marks a spot the model must generate content for. The workhorse generation marker.

entries.name: In-fill + size
entries.description: In-fill with an explicit size constraint (exact or range) so generated content stays proportionate.

entries.name: In-fill + qualifier
entries.description: In-fill with guidance on tone, register, or content of the generation.

entries.name: Literal string
entries.description: Outputs the enclosed text verbatim, suppressing placeholder interpretation. Use to show syntax examples.

entries.name: Omission marker
entries.description: Marks elided content in an example. Use to keep demonstrations short while showing where real content goes.

entries.name: Qualifier pipe
entries.description: Pipe operator appending constraints or guidance to a placeholder, in-fill, or omission.
entries.example: {user.name| formal register}

entries.name: Size indicator
entries.description: Size qualifier constraining generated length (exact, range, or max).
entries.example: Random fact: [...:1-2sentences]

entries.name: Infer continuation
entries.description: Trailing ellipsis telling the model to continue an established pattern.
entries.example: Colors: red, blue, ...

entries.name: Conditional if/else
entries.description: Handlebars conditional rendering one of two content branches.

entries.name: Iteration foreach
entries.description: Iterates a collection, rendering the body per item.
entries.example:
{{foreach [...] as item}}

{{/foreach}}

entries.name: Inverse conditional unless
entries.description: Inverse conditional rendering content only when the condition is false.
entries.example:
{{unless [...]}}

{{/unless}}

entries.name: NPL framework block
entries.description: Declares the NPL framework version in corner-bracket form, setting immutable boundaries for the session.

entries.name: NPL declaration (XHTML)
entries.description: Declares the NPL framework version wrapped in XHTML for strict parsers.
entries.example:

entries.name: Framework extension (XHTML)

[...]
⌞extend:NPL@1.0⌟

entries.name: Corner close marker
entries.description: Bare corner-bracket closer matching the open marker.

entries.name: Conversation prefix
entries.description: Switches the response into natural conversational dialogue mode.

entries.name: Text-to-speech prefix
entries.description: Directs output for spoken-audio rendering.
entries.example: 🔊➤ Convert the shipping confirmation into spoken audio.

entries.name: Speech recognition prefix
entries.description: Directs transcription of audio input into text.
entries.example: 🗣️➤ Transcribe the attached voice memo.

entries.name: Image captioning prefix
entries.description: Directs generation of image captions.
entries.example: 🖼️➤ Caption this mountain landscape photo.

entries.name: Question answering prefix
entries.description: Requests direct factual answers to a specific question.
entries.example: ❓➤ What is the capital of Japan?

entries.name: Topic modeling prefix
entries.description: Requests thematic analysis of the given content.
entries.example: 📊➤ Identify the prevalent themes in these research papers.

entries.name: Translation prefix
entries.description: Requests translation preserving meaning and nuance.
entries.example: 🌐➤ Translate the release notes into Spanish.

entries.name: Entity recognition prefix
entries.description: Requests extraction of named entities from text.
entries.example: 👁️➤ Extract the named entities from this contract.

entries.name: Text generation prefix
entries.description: Requests creative or original prose generation.
entries.example: 🖋️➤ Write an opening paragraph for a futuristic city story.

entries.name: Code generation prefix
entries.description: Requests functional code generation in a specified language.
entries.example: 🖥️➤ [Python] Function to check whether a string is a palindrome.

entries.name: Classification prefix
entries.description: Requests categorization of content into defined classes.
entries.example: 🏷️➤ Categorize this support ticket.

entries.name: Sentiment analysis prefix
entries.description: Requests sentiment or tone assessment.
entries.example: 💡➤ Assess the sentiment of this product review.

entries.name: Summarization prefix
entries.description: Requests a concise summary preserving key information.
entries.example: 📄➤ Summarize the main points of the incident report.

entries.name: Feature extraction prefix
entries.description: Requests systematic extraction of specific features or data points.
entries.example: 🧪➤ Extract dates and amounts from this invoice.

entries.name: Word riddle prefix
entries.description: Requests wordplay or lateral-thinking puzzle handling.
entries.example: 🗣️❓➤ Nothing in the dictionary starts with 'n' and ends with 'g'.
